tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Estimates for $W^{1,p}$, $n < p \le \infty $] ↗ def:version-of-a-function ↗ thm:morreys-inequality ↗ thm:sobolev-extension-theorem ↗ thm:local-smooth-approximation 1. ch5:5.6-thm-5\group Sobolev Inequalities

Let $U$ be a bounded, open subset of $\R ^n$, and suppose $\partial U$ is $C^1$. Assume $n < p \le \infty $, and $u \in W^{1,p}(U)$. Then $u$ has a version $u^* \in C^{0,\gamma }(\bar{U})$, for $\gamma = 1 - \frac{n}{p}$, with the estimate \[ \| u^*\| _{C^{0,\gamma }(\bar{U})} \le C\| u\| _{W^{1,p}(U)}. \] The constant $C$ depends only on $p, n$ and $U$.

Proof

\sketch Extend to compact support in $\mathbb R^n$, mollify, and use Morrey estimate to obtain a Cauchy sequence in the Holder norm. Its limit is the continuous version and inherits the extension bound.

□
